Third-party browser builds used by the quiz export (People > Users > question set > Export).
Loaded on demand from /admin/vendor/ (same origin, so the Content-Security-Policy needs no change).

docx   8.5.0  MIT  https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx   (npm build/index.umd.js, minified with esbuild)
jsPDF  2.5.2  MIT  https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF   (npm dist/jspdf.umd.min.js, unmodified)
